listing.name: Battlestar Galactica - Portrait Pack
listing.summary: For the many BSG fans out there, now you can finally command your very own fleet against the AI threat as Admiral Adama, lead your very own squadron as Starbuck, or colonize planets peacefully as President Laura Roslin.
listing.aiSummary: Adds character portraits from Battlestar Galactica to the game.

description:
Battlestar Galactica - Portrait Pack

For the many BSG fans out there, now you can finally command your very own fleet against the AI threat as Admiral Adama, lead your very own squadron as Starbuck, or colonize planets peacefully as President Laura Roslin.

- All the images were edited to have a vanilla friendly feel to them.
- I've tried including all of the major characters.
- Feel free to criticize, request changes, or make suggestions.

DOWNLOAD
